provenance.observed_description: The tool named this file and its bytes were hashed afterward.
provenance.inferred_description: Attributed from evidence rather than direct observation: either a sandbox scan that could not be split between neighbouring steps, or a file the command line named that existed beforehand — a probable input, not a verified one.
provenance.declared_description: The model asserted this link and nothing verified it.
provenance.hashed_later_description: Hashed when the subagent's record was parsed, not when the step wrote the file — the bytes may already have changed by then.
provenance.not_hashed_large: Not hashed: above the size limit. Identity is size+mtime only.
provenance.not_hashed_unreadable: Not hashed: the file could not be read.
provenance.saved_by_you: saved by you in the editor
provenance.capture_description: Captured when the subagent's record was parsed, not when the step ran — the subagent may have changed the environment in between.
provenance.step_hash_description: This step ran inside a subagent, so the file was hashed when its record was parsed rather than when the step wrote it.
provenance.sandbox_large: Sandbox exceeded the scan budget — file attribution for this step is incomplete.
provenance.scan_failed: The sandbox scan failed — file attribution for this step is incomplete.
provenance.no_baseline: Ran inside a subagent and was reconstructed afterward, so this step's file effects could not be observed directly. Any files below are attributed by timing, not observation.
provenance.root_uploaded_description: You uploaded this file. This is where the chain starts.
provenance.root_user_description: You created this file in the editor; nothing recorded fed into it.
provenance.root_unrecorded_description: No recorded step produced the version that was used here. It predates provenance recording, arrived outside the sandbox API, or was written during a run whose attribution degraded.
provenance.root_budget_description: The upstream walk reached its depth limit here.
provenance.changed_description: The bytes on disk differ from the version this step consumed. Whatever was built from it may not be reproducible from the current file.
provenance.current: Current — the bytes on disk match what the producing step recorded.
provenance.stale: Stale — this file changed after the step that produced it. Anything citing it may describe a different version.
provenance.unknown: Unverified — no recorded hash to compare against, so sameness could not be checked.
provenance.unknown_retrospective: Unchanged since this record was reconstructed — but the producing step ran inside a subagent and its bytes were never hashed at the time, so a match cannot confirm this is what it produced.
provenance.walk_limit: Upstream walk stopped at its limit — the record continues beyond what is shown.
provenance.no_file: This file no longer exists in the sandbox.
provenance.no_history: No recorded provenance. Either this file predates provenance recording, it was uploaded rather than produced by the agent, or it was written during a run whose attribution degraded.
provenance.old_citation: Written before the latest version of this file — the entry may describe different bytes.
provenance.missing_outputs: The remote job never produced {count} requested outputs.
provenance.edges_truncated: + {count} more {count, plural, one {file} other {files}} not recorded (per-step limit)
